title: Your Second Safari: Where to Go Next
excerpt: Been to the Serengeti and Ngorongoro? Ideas for your second safari in Tanzania, from the wild south to chimpanzees.
body:
## The south

[Ruaha](/blog/ruaha-national-park-guide/) and [Nyerere](/blog/nyerere-national-park-guide/).

## The far west

[Katavi](/blog/katavi-national-park-guide/) and [Mahale](/blog/mahale-mountains-chimpanzees/).

## A different season

Saw the river crossings? Try the [calving season](/blog/ndutu-calving-season/).

## On foot

[Walking safaris](/blog/walking-safari-tanzania/).

## Mountains

[Mount Meru](/blog/mount-meru-climb-guide/) or [Kilimanjaro](/climbing-kilimanjaro/).

## Islands

[Pemba](/blog/pemba-island-guide/) and [Mafia](/blog/mafia-island-whale-sharks/).

[Plan your second safari](/travel-proposal/).
